zh.title: LATAM Airlines空中巴士A320在利馬機場起火後疏散
zh.summary: LATAM Airlines A320在利馬（LIM）機場發動機起火後疏散
body: LATAM Airlines一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320），註冊編號CC-BFS，於2026年10月19日在祕魯利馬的Jorge Chávez International Airport（LIM）滑行前往跑道時，發動機起火，機上人員隨後撤離。報導指出，飛機當時準備執行LA 2302航班，目的地為Piura（PIU）；左側CFM56發動機起火，原因尚待查明。
報導稱，所有乘客與機組員均安全撤離，無人受傷。LATAM Airlines已啟動調查，以查明起火原因。

en.title: LATAM Airlines A320 evacuated after engine fire at Lima airport
en.summary: LATAM Airlines evacuated an A320 after an engine fire at Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM).
body: A LATAM Airlines Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), registration CC-BFS, was evacuated after an engine fire while on the tarmac at Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) in Lima, Peru, on October 19, 2026. The aircraft was taxiing toward the runway as it prepared to operate flight LA 2302 to Piura (PIU). The report said the fire began in the port-side CFM56 engine; its cause has not been established.
All passengers and crew evacuated, and no one was injured. LATAM Airlines has launched an investigation to determine the cause of the incident.

zh.title: 西捷航空取消飛往美國兩個目的地的所有航班
zh.summary: 其中一個目的地為夏威夷羣島，另一個將在下一次排班更新中確定
body: 西捷航空（WestJet）宣佈取消飛往美國兩個目的地的所有航班。根據報導，其中一個目的地為夏威夷羣島，另一個目的地將在下一次排班更新中確定。
該消息來自Simple Flying的報導，指出目前尚未公佈具體的第二個目的地。航空公司將在後續的排班更新中提供進一步細節。
此類航班取消可能對旅客行程產生影響，建議旅客密切關注西捷航空的官方公告以獲取最新資訊。

en.title: WestJet Cancels All Flights To 2 US Destinations
en.summary: One of the destinations is a Hawaiian Island, the other will be finalized in the next schedule update
body: WestJet has announced the cancellation of all flights to two US destinations. According to reports, one of the destinations is a Hawaiian Island, while the second destination will be finalized in the next schedule update.
The information was reported by Simple Flying, which noted that the specific second destination has not yet been disclosed. The airline will provide further details in subsequent schedule updates.
Such flight cancellations may impact passenger itineraries, and travelers are advised to monitor WestJet's official announcements for the latest information.

zh.title: 夏威夷航空在檀香山舉辦身心障礙旅客練習飛行
zh.summary: 夏威夷航空10月18日在檀香山為258名身心障礙旅客及家屬舉辦練習飛行
body: 夏威夷航空表示，2026年10月18日在檀香山的Daniel K. Inouye International Airport（HNL）舉辦身心障礙旅客練習飛行，接待258名身心障礙旅客及其家屬登上空中巴士A330。航空公司稱，這是迄今規模最大的身心障礙旅客練習飛行，也是夏威夷航空自2016年以來首次在檀香山舉辦此類活動。
參與者練習了機場旅程中的各個步驟，包括在櫃檯報到、領取登機證、通過安檢、前往登機門及登機。A330隨後推出登機門，在機場滑行後返回，沒有起飛。夏威夷航空表示，活動旨在讓參與者更熟悉航空旅行。

en.title: Hawaiian Airlines holds disability practice flight in Honolulu
en.summary: Hawaiian Airlines hosted 258 travelers with disabilities and their families on an Airbus A330 in Honolulu.
body: Hawaiian Airlines said it welcomed 258 travelers with disabilities and their families aboard an Airbus A330 in Honolulu on October 18, 2026. The event took place at Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL). The airline described it as the largest disability practice flight ever held, and said it was the carrier’s first practice flight in Honolulu since 2016.

Participants practiced airport steps including check-in, receiving boarding passes, passing through security, finding the gate and boarding. The A330 pushed back, taxied around the airport and returned without taking off. Hawaiian Airlines said the event was designed to help participants become more comfortable with air travel.

zh.title: 波音推出Dataliner AI資料平臺，協助航空公司掌握機隊資訊
zh.summary: 波音推出Dataliner平臺，整合航空資料與AI以支援機隊維修及營運決策
body: 波音於2026年10月20日與科技公司Microsoft共同發布Dataliner。波音表示，這項AI航空資料平臺旨在協助航空公司及營運商更深入掌握機隊資訊，並將分散的資料連結為全機隊情報，以支援維修與營運決策。
波音表示，Dataliner可協助客戶預判維修需求、辨識新浮現的風險並及時採取行動。平臺整合航空資料、AI，以及波音的飛機與工程知識，讓使用者能取得較完整的機隊資訊，而非只查看個別飛機資料。
波音指出，航空公司可自行掌控透過Dataliner分享的資料，並透過應用程式、API、分析工具及AI功能使用波音的情報。平臺採用Azure AI Foundry、Microsoft的資料解決方案及其他技術。

en.title: Boeing launches Dataliner AI data platform for airline fleet insights
en.summary: Boeing launched Dataliner with Microsoft to connect aviation data and support fleet maintenance and operational decisions.
body: Boeing unveiled Dataliner on October 20, 2026, in conjunction with technology firm Microsoft. Boeing describes it as an AI-powered aircraft data platform intended to give airlines and operators deeper insight into their fleets. The platform is designed to connect fragmented data into fleet-wide intelligence that supports maintenance and operational decisions.

Boeing says Dataliner will enable customers to anticipate maintenance needs, identify emerging risks and take timely action. It combines aviation data and AI with Boeing’s aircraft and engineering knowledge to provide a more complete view of a fleet than examining data for each aircraft individually.

Boeing says airlines retain control over what they share through Dataliner, and can access Boeing intelligence through applications, APIs, analytics and AI-enabled experiences. The platform uses Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft data solutions and other technologies.

zh.title: 波士頓復飛與 Etihad 波音787跑道進入事件
zh.summary: 波士頓發生復飛；Simple Flying報導Etihad波音787進入跑道
body: Simple Flying 的標題報導波士頓發生復飛，並稱一架未獲準進入跑道的 Etihad 波音 787 進入了跑道。標題同時提到復飛與跑道進入，但這裡不將兩者寫成已確認的因果關係。
報導摘要稱，該機組員已確認需要在跑道前等待，卻仍越過跑道。摘要所述的內容包括機組員對等待要求的確認，以及其後越過跑道；來源沒有在提供的摘要中交代更多事件細節。

en.title: Boston go-around and Etihad Boeing 787 runway entry reported
en.summary: Simple Flying reports a Boston go-around and an Etihad Boeing 787 runway entry.
body: Simple Flying’s headline reports a go-around in Boston and describes an uncleared Etihad Boeing 787 entering the runway. It mentions the go-around and runway entry in the same headline, but the wording here does not present a confirmed causal link between them.

The report summary says the jet’s crew acknowledged the need to hold short of the runway, but crossed it anyway. In other words, the summary describes an acknowledgment that the aircraft needed to wait before the runway, followed by a crossing. It provides no further event details in the supplied excerpt.
